### Sweet Hollow Site Details
- Location: Near downtown St. Paul, adjacent to Bruce Vento Nature Sanctuary
- Site characteristics:
  - Previously sampled in 2022 for depth-based incremental sampling
  - Known for high lead concentrations
  - Contains artifacts and course fragments
  - May have auger refusal issues around 50cm depth
  - Team advised to bring shovels and additional equipment
- Important note: Team should avoid Bruce Vento Nature Sanctuary and Indian Mounds Regional Park due to cultural significance and burial sites (not included on permit)
